shadows.name: glass-clear
shadows.value: rgb(14 15 20 / 0.40); blur 16px, saturate 1.5; ink-line hairline; no shadow
shadows.purpose: Floating controls over artwork at rest.

shadows.name: glass-dark
shadows.value: rgb(14 15 20 / 0.82); blur 16px, saturate 1.5; ink-line hairline; float shadow
shadows.purpose: Title bar, tab pill and mini player over sleeves and Now Playing; floating controls over light artwork.

shadows.name: glass-light
shadows.value: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.80); blur 16px, saturate 1.5; line hairline; soft shadow
shadows.purpose: Title bar, tab pill and mini player over paper pages.

motion.name: finger
motion.value: tracks the finger's travel; settles by a spring started at release velocity
motion.purpose: Every fold: title bar (48px travel), tab pill and mini player (56px travel), Now Playing drag.

motion.name: fold-tap
motion.purpose: Unfolding the tab pill from a tap or a page change, when no finger moves.

motion.name: flight
motion.purpose: Artwork from a list into the sleeve hero; mini player into Now Playing.

motion.name: label
motion.purpose: Play pill width following its label.

motion.name: reduce-motion
motion.purpose: Flights become a 150ms crossfade; folds settle without overshoot but still follow the finger.

narrative.northStar: The Record Sleeve, Folding Into Glass
